fusions.name: Skipping Fry
fusions.desc: Flicks a stinging fry that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. It then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Shoal Burst
fusions.desc: Looses 4 fry in a wide spread, each dealing 6 damage and leaving the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hide in the Branches
fusions.desc: Tucks you into the branches of the reef: a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Cleaner Station
fusions.desc: A bonded cleaner wrasse fights beside you, biting enemies within 4.5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each kill it makes returns 3 health to you.
